exposure: Doppler indices of fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA)
outcome: Neonatal admission to a neonatal intensive care unit
Emergency cesarean section due to abnormal intrapartum cardiotocogram
cohort: 120 low-risk pregnant women beyond 40 weeks of gestation
finding: In low-risk postdates pregnancies, maternal and fetal ultrasound Doppler indices were not significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes.
